Independent qualification report for sealed ooRexx HTTPS Server v0.4

Passed before failure:
- Foreign Runtime v0.14.0
- OpenSSL thread-safe provider contract
- serialized nonblocking TLS boundary
- TLS 1.2/1.3
- HTTP routes and binary echo
- HEAD, pipelining, anti-smuggling, Host validation
- TLS version floor
- 16 concurrent HTTPS clients
- runtime/generation observability

Failure in heavier reset/abort stress:
  curl: (28) Connection timed out after 2001-2002 ms
  FAIL stress good client failed in wave 1

Interpretation carried into v0.4.1:
The prior v0.3 segmentation fault did not recur in the ordinary 16-client phase, but v0.4's one server-wide serialized native gate introduced a liveness/head-of-line bottleneck under heavier mixed good/reset TLS load. The server fix must improve forward progress rather than merely increase client timeout values.
